name: Growth Control
tagline: AI teams for tax firms, installed and run for you
description: Growth Control installs and runs AI teams for independent US tax and accounting firms, including tax practices and bookkeeping/CAS firms. Agents support inquiry response, prospect screening, consultation booking, engagement letters and invoicing under configured approval rules. The managed service includes workflow discovery, system integration, agent setup and ongoing operation. Installation starts at $2,500; scope and ongoing work are quoted individually. Founded by Yaro Korets in Los Angeles in November 2026. Agents do not provide tax advice.
